regime_context: China A-shares show a 'one-narrative' tape: Banks are the sole eligible, broad, crowd-in theme (rank 1, durability 0.74, breadth 0.83, crowded), everything else is weak and narrow. The absolute-trend gate did NOT help on this market's history (mean-reverting tape whipsaws it), so even the headline trend read is experimental; macro backdrop is entirely unscheduled AI-tech/geopolitics chatter, which is coincident noise.
emerging_watch: Watching Banks for a confirmed leadership fade: if 512800.SS closes below its 20-day trailing low while CSI 300 does NOT make a new low, the one-narrative Banks read is weakening. This is a watch, not a call — I am not predicting the handoff, only flagging the condition that would retire the 'Banks lead' assumption.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only theme with a trend-like durability bar (0.74) plus real breadth (0.833) and are the sole eligible narrative. The detector ranks it #1 with a Hurst 'trend' tag, so I lean WITH the prevailing leadership — not because the rank predicts returns (it does not), but because trend persistence is the one leg worth a directional lean here, even though the gate failed on this market historically.
evidence: crowding_z 1.72 (size-down caution only, not a fade)
theses.dissent: Crowding is elevated (z 1.72) and the gate did not hold on this market's history, so a mean-reverting whipsaw is the base risk; the 'leader' could simply be a late-stage concentration that fails to extend.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 by more than 4% from 2026-11-06 through the 15-day check-by window.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: The second eligible theme is Innovative Pharma & CXO, but it is crowded (z 1.38), has a mixed Hurst tag, and weak breadth (0.5) relative to Banks. With only two eligible themes and a one-narrative structure, the non-leading eligible theme is the natural low-conviction underweight directional lean.
theses.dissent: A mean-reverting tape could rotate away from the crowded Banks leader into the second eligible theme precisely because Pharma is less extended; being underweight a crowded-but-second theme has weak edge.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms 512800.SS by 3% or more between 2026-11-06 and the 15-day check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
